required_behavior: Provide opt-in, fenced worker-session continuity for the same Project, flow, profile, and canonical workspace; preserve fresh Implementer isolation. When a blocked non-terminal flow task has exactly one terminal-affinity controller child, create one internal flow attention, let dependency resolution resume the blocked task, and allow only an explicit recovery origin signal to escape the flow.

evidence: At the inspected revision, hermes_cli/kanban_db.py has no session_affinity parameter on create_task, no _pending_flow_attentions helper, and no origin_signal argument on block_task.
A disposable source gate confirmed that session_affinity and recovery origin-signal calls are rejected and that no flow-attention helper exists.

The current public PR 75951 is open. Its GitHub file list contains 48 additions in hermes_cli/kanban_db.py and a 179-line blocked-task session-resume test; its patch resumes a prior session for the same task after respawn. It does not establish the multi-card affinity, Project/workspace fencing, terminal controller routing, or recovery behavior required here.
